name: commune-haho3
description: Portail de la Commune Haho 3 – Kpédomé : frontend (site public) + backend (API PostgreSQL et administration)

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,admin,site -c yellow,magenta,cyan "npm run dev:api --prefix backend" "npm run dev:admin --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix backend && npm run build --prefix frontend
